meta.title: Session overview
meta.description: Open Session overview in the sidebar to browse ordinary sessions, filter by workspace, archive or status, and open a conversation. Title/directory search stays local; optional message-content search uses the existing DSH Host index. Browsing never starts an agent, rewrites a message, archives a session or sends data outside DSH. Archived sessions remain read-only here. Supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.2; disabled or removed plugins leave all sessions unchanged.
